facts.fact: 舞会开场前 Oliver 躲进洗手间找镇定，靠镜子整理头发。
facts.anchor: I excuse myself to the bathroom to try and find some composure.

facts.fact: 十美元赌局：Eden 押他不喜欢特调鸡尾酒，输了，嘟嘴抱怨。
舞池初吻：她的味道是覆盆子、青柠、以及「家」。
facts.anchor: She tastes like raspberries. She tastes like lime. She tastes like home.

facts.fact: 吻毕睁眼，她脸色煞白，Oliver 当场认定自己越界。
她说要吐了——初吻被当场呕吐打断。
facts.anchor: I think I’m going to be sick.

facts.fact: 宿舍楼下 Misty 放行：别担心，你和 Eden 的事我知道。
facts.anchor: Don’t worry. I know about you and Eden.

facts.fact: 浴室里她咕哝「I’m sorry, Ollie」——首次叫出昵称而本人无自觉。
facts.anchor: unaware of her first use of my nickname

facts.fact: 编发是妈妈教的：小时候给妈妈编发是他最爱的差事之一。
facts.anchor: My mum taught me how to braid when I was little
